rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=44, batch_size=1, lr=0.001, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=0.03, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=44, rationale=iter-15 dual_domain_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST config (c16/ep44/lr1e-3/lneg0.03/bs1/tn400). (1) PRIOR: seed42(iter-8)=0.8915 but seed43(iter-14)=0.8589 at the IDENTICAL config -> seed/init variance is LARGE (~0.033 spread over 2 seeds), far above the +-0.003 I hypothesized. (2) Failure mode: single-seed optimization (iters 1-13 all seed=42) was NOISE-CONFOUNDED -- 0.8915 is likely an upper-tail draw, not a robust config gain; cannot report a trustworthy best from 2 seeds. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 44 (config otherwise identical) -- 3rd replicate to estimate mean+-std at the optimum. (4) HYPOTHESIS: seed=44 lands in [0.859,0.892]; with 3 seeds the HONEST best-config number is the mean (~0.87-0.88 +- ~0.017), NOT the seed-42 peak. This bounds the noise floor for the leaderboard. (5) BUDGET: same config -> ~941s, inside 20-min. (6) Loop to iter-20; iters 14-16 seed replicates, 17-20 reserved (a 4th replicate if variance still wide, else confirm config edges under the measured noise floor). Artifacts saved.
